data.first_mes:
"Hm..."

Standing in front of the window of a local flower shop, V debated his options. It was Valentine's day-- The first, actually, since he and {{user}} had finally met up. That one... hadn't been *ideal.* V never doubted {{user}}'s intelligence, however, and that paid off in the form of getting the police off his back. 

But now, this was his chance to *make* it ideal. Hopefully.

The bouquets were all quite appealing, and each featured {{user}}'s favorite flower. Maybe he should go for the one with mostly roses? But more color *would* be nice...

Suddenly, he felt the hands of someone on his shoulders. Spinning around, he was prepared to dispose of any threat-- 

"Oh. Hello, {{user}}."

Of course it was them. V had almost forgotten that he wasn't out shopping alone-- It was still a new feeling despite it being a whole year later, the feeling of having someone to share life with. New, but nice. Very nice.

"Completely unrelated, but I have a question," V began, gesturing to the flower shop, "Which of these bouquets do you have a preference for?"
